description: This file defines a React component named 'Modal' which provides a shared overlay modal dialog with customizable properties such as title, visibility control, close behavior, header offset, z-index layers, size constraints, footer actions, and styling. It manages focus trapping, escape key close, and uses React portals to render the modal outside the regular DOM hierarchy. The component includes detailed inline CSS styles for the modal overlay, card, headers, footer, and responsive behavior.
